title: Ehtiyot: fayl tahlili adashadigan 5 joy
caption: ⚠️ Fayl tahlili adashadigan 5 joy Kod bilan hisoblash taxmindan yaxshi. Lekin kod ham faylni noto'g'ri o'qishi mumkin. Beshta joy va har biriga bitta nazorat savoli: 1. Sana. 03.04.2025 — uchinchi aprelmi, to'rtinchi martmi? Kod ko'pincha amerikacha o'qiydi. → Sanalar kun.oy.yil formatida. Eng erta va eng kech sanani ko'rsat. 2. Matn bo'lib qolgan raqam. «1 250 000» probel bilan yozilsa, yig'indiga kirmay qoladi. → Qaysi ustunlarda raqam matn bo'lib turibdi? Nechta katak? 3. Sarlavha. Jadval tepasida nom yoki birlashtirilgan katak bo'lsa, ustunlar siljib ketadi. → Sarlavhani qaysi qatordan olding? Ustun nomlarini sanab ber. 4. Faqat boshini ko'rish. AI birinchi qatorlarga qarab xulosa aytishi mumkin. → Nechta qator qayta ishlandi? Javob fayldagi qatorlar soniga teng bo'lishi kerak. 5. Kodsiz javob. AI hisoblamasdan raqam aytadi. → Kodni va uning natijasini ko'rsat. 🧪 Sinab ko'ring: bu hafta fayllarida uchala tuzoq ham bor. murojaatlar_2025.xlsx da 6 ta sana matn bo'lib yozilgan va sarlavha 3-qatorda, buxgalteriya.xlsx da 5 ta qiymat matn. AI ularni o'zi aytdimi? 💡 Bugungi yangi bilim: AI ning javobini emas, hisoblash yo'lini tekshirasiz. Besh savol — ikki daqiqa. 🎁 Olib keting: 5 nazorat savoli — rasmni saqlab qo'ying, har tahlildan keyin bering. ➖➖➖ {{CHANNEL}} #ehtiyot
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Style: clean paper-cut editorial illustration — flat layered shapes with soft shadows, like a neatly filled-in office form. Warm off-white paper background (#F5F2E9), deep navy ink (#141C2B) and one accent colour (#D7263D). Calm, trustworthy, no clutter.

1) Top-left: a small solid #D7263D rounded rectangle with white bold uppercase monospace text "EHTIYOT BO'LING".
2) Center: a paper checklist with five rows on a clipboard; a small warning triangle stamp in the accent colour on the top corner. Paper-cut style, matte, generous empty space around it. No people's faces, no real logos, no state emblems or flags.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold navy headline in a characterful grotesque sans-serif, at most three lines: "Fayl tahlili adashadigan 5 joy"
4) Bottom, above a thin hairline: left small monospace navy text "AI darslar".

Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes. No other text, no watermarks.
notes: Rasmning o'zi — «olib keting» kartochkasi: 5 tuzoq va 5 savol. Savollar postda <code> ichida — bosilsa nusxalanadi.
